name: Snare
material: 25 ft. of rope, which the spell consumes
description: Form a magical trap in a 10 ft. circle on the ground or floor. The next time a Small, Medium, or Large creature moves into the spell's radius, it must succeed on a Reflex saving throw or be restrained into the air and left hanging upside down by several feet. A restrained creature may remake the saving throw at the end of its turn. Alternatively, a different creature may use a Major Action to make a Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell save DC, ending the effect on a success. The trap is nearly invisible and requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to be discerned.
